description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various biomedical named entity categories, likely derived from a dataset related to the referenced paper on biomedical named entity recognition. The chart displays a total of 25 distinct slices, which are visually ordered by descending size in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the top right. There is no separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned outside the perimeter of the chart adjacent to their respective slices, while percentage values are displayed directly inside each segment. None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding. The largest segment is "Chemical" (blue) at 32%, followed by "Protein" (orange) at 15%, and "DNA" (green) at 6%. The subsequent slices include "Chemical Family" (red, 5%), "Disease" (purple, 5%), "Cell Type" (brown, 5%), "Drug" (pink, 4%), "Frequency" (grey, 3%), "Cell Line" (yellow, 3%), "Dosage" (cyan, 3%), and "Strength" (blue, 3%). Continuing counter-clockwise, the chart shows "Gene Or Gene Product" (orange, 2%), "Form" (green, 2%), "Disease Or Phenotypic Feature" (red, 2%), and "Reason" (purple, 2%). The remaining smallest slices, clustered tightly on the right side, include "Route" (brown, 1%), "Chemical Entity" (pink, 1%), "Sequence Variant" (grey, 1%), "Modifier" (yellow, 1%), "RNA" (cyan, 1%), "Disease Class" (blue, 1%), and "Organism Taxon" (orange, 1%). The final three visible slivers are labeled "Duration" (green), "ADE" (red), and "Composite Mention" (purple), each displaying a rounded value of 0%.
